Genpact LTD is listed as a public company with headquarters in Hamilton, D0, trading under the ticker G and holding SEC CIK 0001398659. Its listed website is generali.com.

The text harvested from that site does not describe Genpact LTD. It presents Generali Group, described as the corporate website of Assicurazioni Generali Group, offering information about its activities, financial data, news, CSR, career opportunities and history. The site also refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which it says will enhance excellence across customer relationships, the group operating model and core capabilities. No AI products are described in the material.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
